column6: On Christmas Eve a miserly old businessman is visited by the ghost of his partner and three spirits who show him his past, present and future.

column2: Янки при дворе короля Артура (Твен; Фёдорова)
column6: A factory superintendent from Connecticut wakes up in sixth-century Camelot and sets about modernising the kingdom.
An eccentric American inventor claims an English earldom, while the earl's democratic son goes to America to live as a plain man.
In a slave-holding river town an enslaved woman swaps her baby with her master's, and a lawyer with a hobby of fingerprints unravels it years later.
Tom, Huck and Jim are carried off across the Atlantic in an inventor's balloon and come down over the Sahara.
A Boston gentleman falls asleep in 1887 and wakes in the year 2000 in a peaceful socialist America.
A gentleman dies before he can prove his secret marriage, and his two disinherited sons go out into the world, one into crime and one under a rich uncle's care.
A devout enslaved man is sold away from his family in Kentucky, while a young mother flees north across the frozen Ohio with her son.
In an Alsatian village inn, the innkeeper's son and his father's niece fall in love against the old man's wishes.
